observations.body: Many contributions are ordered toward building up. What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up. for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

payload.tension: The passage states many contributions are ordered toward building up. What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up. for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
